unimplemented: No independent reassessment of the underlying evidence establishing possession or failing to establish title is implemented.
OPEN_TEXT: The legal evaluation of whether conduct amounts to effective, peaceful, and settled possession rather than transient trespass is not executable as a deterministic checklist.
No numerical minimum duration, mandatory crop requirement, or mechanically sufficient conjunction of the cited factors is implemented.
No independent factual assessment of duration, owner knowledge, acquiescence, or possessory intention is possible from the supplied judgment alone.
The court's reported finding can be accepted under the reconstruction policy, but doing so is not equivalent to independently executing the underlying settled-possession test.
No independent evaluation of the detailed manner of interference, the complete pleadings, or additional discretionary considerations governing injunctions is implemented.
The rule does not independently execute R2's OPEN_TEXT settled-possession evaluation.
The full pleadings are unavailable for independent verification of the precise declaratory relief requested or omitted.
No complete procedural test for all circumstances in which a declaration might be required is reconstructed.
No independent analysis of the cited High Court decisions is performed beyond the Supreme Court's descriptions of those decisions.
No independent application of evidentiary presumptions about possession and title to decide ultimate ownership is performed.
No independent adjudication of the competing proprietary claims or the disputed boundary is implemented.
No prospective determination of either party's title or superior right to possession is implemented.
No future procedural admissibility, limitations question, or evidentiary sufficiency assessment is implemented.
The judgment's condition requiring establishment of a better right is preserved, but no further allocation or standard of proof is invented.
